text:
Marta Gonzalez: Quick ask — we need updated inputs from hardware partners for the Q3 cost model. Specifically: reserved commit windows, minimum monthly guarantees, spot eviction cadence, daypart/region supply skew, and any crediting rules when preempts occur. Can partners paste a CSV snippet or bullet list of values?

Raj Patel: +1 finance wants per-sku effective hourly price at 50%/80%/100% utilization, and the rebate/credit rules for evictions. important for P&L sims.

Anya Li: Also need guidance on ramp/down lead times (how fast reserved capacity can be shifted between zones) — affects how we model regional fallbacks. tiny CSV column: sku,region,commit_tenor_months,min_guarantee_hours,eviction_rate_per_1000h,preempt_credit_pct,ramp_hours

Corey Wu: For infra, an eviction pattern time series would be gold — e.g., typical hourly spot availability over a week for each region. If vendors can share a small sample (7x24) that would help with stochastic sims.

vendor-bot: Reminder: upload attachments in the partner workspace folder or tag @partnerships so we don't miss uploads.

Linas Koval (VoltCloud): Hey Marta — can provide the following for our A100-like SKU: 1) commit_tenor_months: 12, 2) min_guarantee_hours: 480 (20h/mo), 3) effective_hourly_price_usd: {"50%": "2.10", "80%": "1.75", "100%": "1.35"}, 4) eviction_rate_per_1000h: 2.8, 5) preempt_credit_pct: 25%, 6) regional_skew: {"us-east": 0.55, "eu-west": 0.30, "apac": 0.15}, 7) ramp_hours: 4.

Devon Hart: thanks Linas. can you also share how credits are issued? immediate credit vs invoice-offset vs future bill credit? we have to map to different accounting treatments.

Linas Koval (VoltCloud): invoice-offset today, but can offer future bill credit for enterprise deals. For marketplace SKUs we issue invoice-offset within 72h.

Marta Gonzalez: perfect. Can you paste CSV header + one line example? we'll ingest to the cost model.

Linas Koval (VoltCloud): sure —
```
sku,region,commit_tenor_months,min_guarantee_hours,eviction_rate_per_1000h,preempt_credit_pct,effective_price_50,effective_price_80,effective_price_100,ramp_hours,credit_method
volt-a100-us,us-east,12,480,2.8,25,2.10,1.75,1.35,4,invoice-offset
```

Anya Li: perfect format. we'll add these fields to the ingestion spec (and tag if any special clauses). one more ask — do partners have blackout windows where reserved capacity cannot be shifted? annotate as blackout_start/blackout_end (local tz).

Linas Koval (VoltCloud): we have monthly maintenance windows on the 3rd Sunday 02:00-05:00 UTC for some zones — will add blackout_start/blackout_end columns.

Raj Patel: FYI, if partner offers graduated rebates for longer tenors (e.g., 6/12/24 mo), include tenor_multiplier_pct column so we can model blended unit economics.

Corey Wu: Also, if vendors can provide a tiny sample of prefix/KV-cache behavior impact (e.g., sustained 2k concurrent sessions with 1024 context vs 256 context) that'd help sizing. Not necessary in CSV, just attach a short note.

Marta Gonzalez: next steps: 1) partners reply in this thread or upload CSV to /partners/cost-inputs/ with filename <partner>-supply-YYYYMMDD.csv, 2) Partnerships will validate schema, 3) Finance + Eng will run baseline sims and flag gaps by EOD Fri. tagging @Linas for follow-up. :thumbsup:

Linas Koval (VoltCloud): will upload by EOD tomorrow.

vendor-bot: File uploaded: /partners/cost-inputs/voltcloud-supply-20240719.csv (1.2KB)

Devon Hart: grabbing it now. if anyone else has partials, drop them here — we can merge.

Marta Gonzalez: thanks team — I'll collate and share aggregated assumptions spreadsheet after validation.

Anya Li: cc finance — we'll need the final inputs by Monday to lock Q3 SKU pricing buckets.

Raj Patel: noted. thanks everyone.
